provenance.gap_layers_reason: duty mesh.gapLayers = 1/side.  Static map: 3/side — the deployed gap rule refined the full-period static probe (144 steps/period) to 3/side (Coulomb ring self-check gate 5 % of the ripple scale); the 60° window passed at 1.  Loss runs: duty 1/side, rule on (the TDM rated probe ended at 1).
provenance.static_window: 60° electrical, 144 steps/period (24 positions, 12 per cogging cycle)

peak_rule.source: L12 owner peak/rated current ratio 48.79/42.78 applied to I0 (labelled assumption; the L20 card's peak needs an owner duty)

T_operating_Nm.method: settled loss-grid FEM: TDM coupled eddy + demag steady state (Coulomb)

P_loss_em_W.method: loss-grid FEM total (Cu DC+AC, iron, magnet, shaft)

k_state_split.method: same settled TDM point with demag OFF: demag share = T(demag)/T(no demag); the rest (coupled eddy reaction, 36-step sampling, duty gap layers) = T(no demag)/T_map

peak_point.I_source: ASSUMPTION — no owner peak duty: L12 owner peak/rated current ratio 48.79/42.78 applied to I0 (labelled assumption; the L20 card's peak needs an owner duty)

k_state.method: operating/virgin torque factor of the loss trajectory, nearest current row, linear in n

P_loss_em_W.method: loss-trajectory interpolation (per-group n^k, linear in I)

Km_Nm_per_sqrtW.method: T_cold(I0)/√(3·I0²·R20), DC copper incl. end windings

Ld_bench_mH.method: symmetric ±2 A pairs on the d and q axes, Δpsi/Δi (true small-signal differential at I ≈ 0; bench/LCR equivalent)

Lq_bench_mH.method: symmetric ±2 A pairs on the d and q axes, Δpsi/Δi (true small-signal differential at I ≈ 0; bench/LCR equivalent)

Ld_frozen_2A_mH.method: solver inc_ldq: frozen-permeability (secant ν) at 2 A — NOT the differential (P20)

Lq_frozen_2A_mH.method: solver inc_ldq at 2 A (frozen secant ν)

Ld_chord_rated_mH.method: (psi_d − psi_PM)/i_d at the cold rated MTPA vertex (withheld when |i_d| < 10 % of |i|)

Lq_chord_rated_mH.method: psi_q/i_q at the cold rated vertex

cogging_pp_Nm.method: cold no-load torque p-p, full period, cogging-quality sampling (Coulomb)

I_char_rms_A.method: psi_d = 0 on the d-axis (3 static points, quadratic fit) — characteristic current, not the SC transient

I_sc_steady_rated_speed_rms_A.method: steady 3-ph short circuit at n0 from both dq equations with R20, linearised cold map

bus_crossing_speed_vmax_rpm.method: cold-magnet bus-crossing speed = Kv_cold × v_max (uncontrolled-generator threshold, NOT a mechanical runaway; no modulation margin)

Kt_rated_Nm_per_A.method: hot MTPA vertex at I0 (virgin map)

Kt_operating_Nm_per_A.method: rated loss-grid point (demag + eddy, operating angle)

R_phase_ohm.method: solver R_phase at the hot winding temperature

Ld_small_signal_mH.method: symmetric ±2 A pairs on the d and q axes, Δpsi/Δi (true small-signal differential at I ≈ 0; bench/LCR equivalent)

Lq_small_signal_mH.method: symmetric ±2 A pairs on the d and q axes, Δpsi/Δi (true small-signal differential at I ≈ 0; bench/LCR equivalent)

Ld_incremental_rated_mH.method: frozen-permeability incremental at the hot rated vertex (NOT the true differential, P20)

Lq_incremental_rated_mH.method: frozen-permeability incremental at the hot rated vertex

Ld_differential_rated_mH.method: ∂psi_d/∂i_d of the C¹ map (true differential incl. saturation; central difference h = 1 % of the map radius)

summary.rotor_mass_source: rotor iron + magnets + shaft + sleeve, measured on the CAD polygons
summary.model: SKF frictional-moment model (tables 2 and 3) + analytic windage — ANALYTIC, not FEM
notes: Unbalanced magnetic pull is NOT modelled: an off-centre rotor is pulled toward the short side by a force that can exceed its own weight, and it would go straight into F_r. Nor are coupling, belt or gear side loads, or any seal on the shaft itself.
radial load = rotor weight, half each (no bearing span given)
